bases.name: Mermaid Pool
bases.text: On your turn, if you have a minion here, you may move another player’s minion to here.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，如果你这里有一个随从，你可以将另一个玩家的随从移动到这里。

bases.name: Mermaid Reef
bases.text: During your turn, other players’ minions here add 1 less power to their controller’s total.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，其他玩家的随从为其控制器的总力量减少 1 点。

bases.name: Sheep Shrine
bases.text: After this is played, each player may move one of their minions to here. If played during setup, replace it and shuffle it into the deck.
bases.textZh: 此基地牌打出后，每名玩家可以将其一个随从移动到此处。若在设置期间打出此基地牌，将其替换并洗回基地牌组。

bases.name: The Pasture
bases.text: After the first time you move a minion to this base each turn, move another minion from there to here.
bases.textZh: 每回合第一次将一个随从移动到此基地后，将另一个随从从那里移动到这里。

bases.name: Boneyard
bases.text: Once during your turn, after a minion you own of power 3 or less goes to the discard pile from another base, you may bury it here.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，当你拥有3或以下力量的随从从另一个基地进入弃牌堆后，你可以将其埋在这里。

bases.name: Ossuary
bases.text: On your turn, you may bury a minion of power 3 or less from your discard pile here.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，你可以从你的弃牌堆中埋葬一个力量为 3 或更少的随从。

bases.name: Arena
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here during your turn, you may play an extra action or draw a card.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中首次在此处打出随从后，你可以打出一张额外战术，或抽一张牌。

bases.name: Hall of Fame
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here during your turn, it gains +2 power until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中第一次在这里打出随从后，它会获得+2力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Field of Honor
bases.text: After the first time you destroy another player's minion here each turn, gain 1 VP.
bases.textZh: 每回合第一次消灭其他玩家的随从后，获得 1 VP。

bases.name: Tsar's Palace
bases.text: If you do not have more power here than each other player, you cannot play minions here of power 2 or less.
bases.textZh: 如果你在这里没有比其他玩家更多的力量，你就不能在这里打出力量为 2 或更少的随从。

bases.name: Haunted House
bases.text: After a player plays a minion here, that player must discard a card.
bases.textZh: 当玩家在这里打出一个随从后，该玩家必须弃掉一张牌。

bases.name: The Dread Gazebo
bases.text: Players cannot play actions on this base.
bases.textZh: 玩家不能在此基地打出战术。

bases.name: Secret Grove
bases.text: On your turn, you may play one extra minion of power 2 or less here.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，你可以在这里额外打出一个力量为 2 或更少的随从。

bases.name: The Greenhouse
bases.text: After this base scores and is replaced, the winner may search their deck for a minion and play it on the replacement base.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分并被替换后，获胜者可以在自己的牌组中搜索一个随从并在替换基地上使用它。

bases.name: Inventor's Salon
bases.text: After this base scores, the winner may draw an action from their discard pile.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，获胜者可以将其弃牌堆中的一张战术加入手上。

bases.name: Workshop
bases.text: After the first time each turn you play an action on this base, you may play an extra action.
bases.errata: Yes (Functional - capped at once per turn)
bases.textZh: 每回合你第一次在此基地上打出一张战术后，你可以打出一张额外战术。
bases.errataZh: 有（功能性：每回合限一次）

bases.name: Critter Combat Club
bases.text: You may play an extra minion of power 2 or less here on your turn. If you control it at the end of the turn, place it on the bottom of your deck.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，你可以额外打出一个力量为 2 或更少的随从。如果你在回合结束时控制了它，则将它放置到你的牌库底部。

bases.name: Itty City
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may shuffle a random minion from your discard pile into your deck.
bases.textZh: 每回合你第一次在这里打出一个随从后，你可以将一个随机随从从你的弃牌堆洗入你的牌库。

bases.name: Kaiju Island
bases.text: Titans here do not make other titans leave. Each titan here adds +3 power to its controller’s power here.
bases.textZh: 这里的泰坦不会让其他泰坦离开。这里的每个泰坦都会为其控制器的力量添加 +3 力量。

bases.name: Tokyo
bases.text: After you play an action on this base, you gain +3 power here until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 当你在此基地上打出一张战术后，你在这里获得+3力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Akihabara High
bases.text: After you play a minion here, your other minions here gain +1 power until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，你在这里的其他随从获得+1力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Q Point
bases.text: Before this base scores, each player destroys all of their minions and actions on this base but one card total.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，每名玩家消灭其在此基地上的所有随从和战术，但各保留其中一张牌。

bases.name: Juice Bar
bases.text: Before this base scores, each player with a minion here may play an extra minion here (starting with the current player).
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，每个拥有随从的玩家都可以在这里打出额外的随从（从当前玩家开始）。

bases.name: Moon Dumpster
bases.text: Once on your turn, you may play a minion here of power 3 or less. You may not move your minions away from this base.
bases.textZh: 一旦轮到你，你可以在这里打出一个力量为 3 或更少的随从。你不可以将你的随从从此基地移走。

bases.name: Hive of Scum and Villainy
bases.text: After the first time each turn that you play an action that directly increases the power of one of your minions here, draw a card.
bases.imageAlt: Hive of Scum and Villainy · Smash Up
bases.textZh: 在你每回合第一次执行直接增加你的一个随从力量的战术后，抽一张牌。

bases.name: No-Moon
bases.text: Before this base scores, destroy a random other base (replace it normally).
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，随机摧毁一个其他基地（正常替换）。

bases.name: Changing Room
bases.text: After a minion here uses a talent, it gains +1 power until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 这里的随从使用天赋后，它会获得+1力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Unicrave
bases.text: Before this base scores, replace it with the top card of the base deck. Keep all cards on it, discard this card, and keep scoring.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，将其替换为基地牌库的顶牌。保留所有牌，丢弃这张牌，然后继续得分。

bases.name: Spikey Chair Room
bases.text: At the end of any turn that a player has played at least one minion here, they may destroy a minion they own to draw a card.
bases.textZh: 在玩家在这里至少使用了一个随从的任何回合结束时，他们可以消灭自己拥有的一个随从来抽一张牌。

bases.name: Wintersquashed
bases.text: After you play a minion here, you may give control of it to another player.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以将其控制权交给另一个玩家。

bases.name: Neutral Space
bases.text: Minions here are not affected by other players’ minions here.
bases.textZh: 这里的随从不会受到其他玩家的随从的影响。

bases.name: USS Undertaking
bases.text: At the start of your turn, you may move one of your minions to here, or from here to another base.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，你可以将你的一个随从移动到这里，或者从这里移动到另一个基地。

bases.name: The Homeworld
bases.text: Once per turn, after you play a minion here, you may play an extra minion of power 2 or less.
bases.errata: Yes, Functional (changed to once per turn)
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以额外打出一个力量为 2 或更少的随从。
bases.errataZh: 有（功能性：改为每回合一次）

bases.name: The Mothership
bases.text: After this base scores, the winner may return one of his or her minions of power 3 or less from here to his or her hand.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，获胜者可以将其一名力量为 3 或以下的随从从此处移回其拥有者的手上。

bases.name: Jungle Oasis
bases.text: (no ability)
bases.textZh: （无能力）

bases.name: Tar Pits
bases.text: When a minion here would be destroyed for the first time each turn, place it on the bottom of its owners' deck instead.
bases.textZh: 当这里的随从每回合第一次被消灭时，请将其放在其拥有者牌组的底部。
bases.errataZh: 有（功能性：现为每回合一次）

bases.name: Ninja Dojo
bases.text: (no ability)
bases.textZh: （无能力）

bases.name: Temple of Goju
bases.text: After each time a minion is destroyed here, place it at the bottom of its owner's deck
bases.textZh: 每次在这里消灭一个随从后，将其放置在其拥有者牌组的底部

bases.name: The Grey Opal
bases.text: After this base scores, all players other than the winner may move a minion from here to another base instead of the discard pile
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，除获胜者之外的所有玩家都可以将随从从这里移动到另一个基地，而不是丢弃堆

bases.name: Tortuga
bases.text: After this base scores and is replaced, the runner-up may move one of their minions on another base to the replacement base.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分并被替换后，亚军可以将另一个基地的一名随从移至替换基地。

bases.name: Factory 436-1337
bases.text: When this base scores, the winner gains 1 VP for every 5 power that player has here.
bases.textZh: 当此基地计分时，获胜者每拥有 5 点力量即可获得 1 VP。

bases.name: The Central Brain
bases.text: Each minion here has +1 power.
bases.textZh: 这里的每个随从都有+1力量。

bases.name: Cave of Shinies
bases.text: Once per turn, after a minion here you own is destroyed, gain 1 VP.
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，当你拥有的随从被消灭后，获得 1 点 VP。

bases.name: Mushroom Kingdom
bases.text: At the start of your turn, if you have more cards in your hand than any other player, you may move a minion to or from this base.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，如果你手上的牌多于任何其他玩家，你可以将一个随从移入或移出此基地。

bases.name: School of Wizardry
bases.text: After this base scores, the winner looks at the top three cards of the base deck, chooses one to replace this base, and returns the others in any order.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，获胜者查看基地牌库顶部的三张牌，选择一张替换此基地牌，并按任意顺序返回其他牌。

bases.name: The Great Library
bases.text: After this base scores, all players with minions here may draw one card.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，所有拥有随从的玩家都可以抽一张牌。

bases.name: Evans City Cemetery
bases.text: After this base scores, the winner discards his or her hand and draws five cards.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，获胜者弃掉其所有手牌并抽五张牌。

bases.name: Rhodes Plaza Mall
bases.text: When this base scores, each player gains 1 VP for each minion that player has here.
bases.textZh: 当此基地计分时，每名玩家在此处每有一名随从便获得 1 VP。

bases.name: Building Rooftop
bases.text: At the start of your turn, if you have exactly one minion here, you may reduce the breakpoint of this base by that minion's power until the end of the turn. When this base scores, each player with exactly one minion here gains 1 VP.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，如果你这里只有一个随从，你可以将此基地的临界点减少该随从的力量，直到回合结束。当此基地计分时，每个拥有一个随从的玩家都会获得 1 VP。

bases.name: Jungle Camp
bases.text: After this base scores, the winner may return one of their minions here to their hand.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，获胜者可以将他们的一个随从移回手牌。

bases.name: Alternate Present
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may place two stasis counters on a card from your hand.
bases.textZh: 在你每回合第一次在这里打出随从后，你可以在你手上的一张牌上放置两个停滞标记。

bases.name: Time-Traveling Car
bases.text: After this base scores, the winner may place two stasis counters on one of their minions or actions here.
bases.errata: Yes, Functional (minor, change of timing and specifies "minion or action")
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，获胜者可以在其位于此处的一名随从或一张战术上放置两个停滞标记。
bases.errataZh: 有（功能性：微调时机，并明确为“随从或战术”）

bases.name: Ancient Crashed Ship
bases.text: After you play a minion here from anywhere except your hand, place a +1 power counter on it.
bases.textZh: 当你从手牌以外的任何地方打出一个随从后，在它上面放置一个+1战斗力标记。

bases.name: Brood Hive
bases.text: Before this base scores, starting with the player to the current player's left, each player with a minion here may play an extra minion off the top of their deck here.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，从当前玩家左边的玩家开始，这里有一个随从的每个玩家都可以在他们的牌组顶部打出一个额外的随从。

bases.name: Rooftop Portal
bases.text: Once per turn, after you destroy a card here, draw a card.
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，你破坏此处的一张卡后，抽一张牌。

bases.name: Wraithrustlers HQ
bases.text: The winner, on their next turn, may play an extra action or an extra minion.
bases.textZh: 获胜者在其下个回合可以打出一张额外战术或一个额外随从。

bases.name: Sewer Hideout
bases.text: After you play your second action in a turn, you may place a +1 power counter on a minion here
bases.textZh: 当你在一个回合中打出第二张战术后，你可以在此处的一名随从上放置一个 +1 战斗力标记。

bases.name: Technoball
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may play an extra action.
bases.textZh: 每回合首次在此处打出随从后，你可以打出一张额外战术。

bases.name: G.I. Gerald's Base
bases.text: Once per turn, after you play a minion here, you may draw a card and place a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以抽一张牌并将一张牌从你的手牌放在你的牌组底部

bases.name: USS Banner
bases.text: On your turn, you may play an extra minion here of power 2 or less. If you control it at the end of the turn, place it on top of your deck.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，你可以在这里额外打出一个力量为 2 或更少的随从。如果你在回合结束时控制了它，则将其置于你的牌库顶。

bases.name: Concert Venue
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may place a +1 power counter on it
bases.textZh: 每回合你第一次在这里打出随从后，你可以在它上面放置一个+1战斗力标记

bases.name: Recording Studio
bases.text: At the start of each turn, all players' minions here gain +1 power until the end of the turn
bases.textZh: 每回合开始时，所有玩家的随从获得+1力量，直到回合结束

bases.name: Power Castle
bases.text: Once per turn, after an action is played on or transferred to a minion here, you may place a +! power counter on that minion
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，当一张战术被打出到或转移到此处的一名随从上后，你可以在该随从上放置一个 +1 战斗力标记。

bases.name: Slime Pool
bases.text: Instead of your regular action play, you may play a play-on-minion action off the top of your deck on a minion here.
bases.textZh: 你可以不进行常规战术打出，改为从你的牌组顶打出一张“打出到随从上”的战术，并将其打出到此处的一名随从上。

bases.name: Dragon's Lair
bases.text: When this base scores, the winner draws 3 cards.
bases.textZh: 当此基地计分时，获胜者抽3张牌。

bases.name: Wyrm's Desolation
bases.text: Each minion here has -1 power.
bases.textZh: 这里的每个随从都有-1力量。

bases.name: Oracle at Delphi
bases.text: After you play a minion here, reveal the top card of your deck. If it is an action, draw it; otherwise return it.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，展示你牌组顶牌。如果是战术，就画出来；否则退回。

bases.name: Wooden Horse
bases.text: After any player plays an action, he or she may give a minion here +2 power until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 任何玩家打出一张战术后，他或她可以给这里的一个随从+2力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Shark Reef
bases.text: After a minion is destroyed here, the player that destroyed it may place a +1 power counter on one of their minions.
bases.textZh: 当一个随从在这里被摧毁后，摧毁它的玩家可以在他们的一个随从上放置一个+1战斗力标记。

bases.name: The Deep
bases.text: After you play a minion here, if it has power 4 or more, you may destroy a minion with less power here.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，如果它的力量为4或更多，你可以在这里消灭一个力量较小的随从。

bases.name: Converted Cave
bases.text: Minions of power 2 or less cannot be destroyed here except by their controller.
bases.textZh: 力量为 2 或以下的随从无法在此被消灭，除非被其操控者摧毁。

bases.name: Crystal Fortress
bases.text: After you play a minion here, you may place a minion from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以将你的弃牌堆中的一个随从放到你牌库的底部。

bases.name: Tornado Alley
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may move another minion to here from another base.
bases.textZh: 每回合你第一次在这里打出一个随从后，你可以从另一个基地移动另一个随从到这里。

bases.name: Trailer Park
bases.text: After you move a minion to here, place a +1 power counter on it.
bases.textZh: 将一个随从移动到此处后，在其上放置一个+1战斗力标记。

bases.name: Egg Chamber
bases.text: Minions here with +1 power counters cannot be destroyed.
bases.textZh: 这里拥有 +1 战斗力标记的随从无法被消灭。

bases.name: The Hill
bases.text: At the start of your turn, you may move one of your minions to this base.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，你可以将你的一个随从移动到此基地。

bases.name: Golem Schloß
bases.text: After this base scores, the winner places a +1 power counter on each of their minions.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，获胜者在他们的每个随从上放置一个+1战斗力标记。

bases.name: Laboratorium
bases.text: After the first time each turn a minion is played here, its controller places a +1 power counter on it.
bases.textZh: 每回合第一次打出随从后，其控制者会在其上放置一个 +1 战斗力标记。

bases.name: Castle Blood
bases.text: Once per turn, after you destroy a minion on another base, you may bury it here. The breakpoint of this base is reduced by 2 for each buried card here.
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，当你消灭另一个基地的随从后，你可以将它埋在这里。每埋入一张牌，此基地的临界点就会减少 2。

bases.name: Crypt
bases.text: After you destroy one or more minions, you may place a +1 power counter on one of your minions here.
bases.textZh: 当你消灭一个或多个随从后，你可以在你的一个随从身上放置一个+1战斗力标记。

bases.name: Moot Site
bases.text: After the first time each turn a minion is played here, it gains +2 power until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 每回合第一次在这里打出随从后，它会获得+2力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Standing Stones
bases.text: During your turn, one of your minions here can use its Talent twice.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，你的一个随从可以使用其天赋两次。

bases.name: Pyramids
bases.text: On your turn, you may bury a card from your hand here.
bases.textZh: 轮到你的时候，你可以将手上的一张牌埋在这里。

bases.name: Star Portal
bases.text: After a card is buried here or an action is played on this base, its controller draws a card.
bases.textZh: 当一张牌被埋在这里或在此基地上打出一张战术后，其控制者会抽一张牌。

bases.name: Saloon
bases.text: After a minion here is destroyed, each player with a minion here may draw a card.
bases.textZh: 当这里的随从被消灭后，这里有随从的每个玩家都可以抽一张牌。

bases.name: So-so Corral
bases.text: After you play a minion here, it may duel another player's minion here. Destroy the losing minion.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，它可能会在这里与另一个玩家的随从决斗。消灭失败的随从。

bases.name: Sakura Garden
bases.text: Each turn, the first time one of your minions here goes to the discard pile, draw a card.
bases.textZh: 每回合，当你的一个随从第一次进入弃牌堆时，抽一张牌。

bases.name: Shogun's Palace
bases.text: Once per turn, after you play a minion here, it may duel another player’s minion here. The controller of the winning minion draws two cards.
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，当你在这里打出一个随从后，它可能会在这里与另一个玩家的随从决斗。获胜随从的操控者抽两张牌。

bases.name: Drakkar
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may reveal the top card of another player’s deck. If it is an action or a minion of power 3 or less, you may draw it. Otherwise, return it.
bases.textZh: 每回合首次在此处打出随从后，你可以展示另一名玩家牌组顶牌。若它是一张战术或力量为 3 或以下的随从，将其加入你的手上；否则放回原处。

bases.name: Longhouse
bases.text: On your turn, you may place a card from your hand on top of your deck to give one of your minions here +2 power until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，你可以将一张手牌放在你的牌库顶，让你的一个随从获得 +2 力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Enchanted Glen
bases.text: After you play an action on a minion here, draw a card.
bases.textZh: 当你将一张战术打出到此处的一名随从上后，抽一张牌。

bases.name: Fairy Circle
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may play an extra minion here or play an extra action.
bases.textZh: 每回合第一次在这里打出随从后，您可以在这里额外打出一个随从或打出一张额外战术。

bases.name: Cool Cats' Alley
bases.text: Once on your turn, you may destroy one of your minions here to draw a card.
bases.textZh: 一旦轮到你，你可以消灭这里的一个随从来抽一张牌。

bases.name: The House of Nine Lives
bases.text: If a minion at another base would be destroyed, its owner may move it here instead.
bases.imageAlt: The House of Nine Lives · Smash Up
bases.textZh: 如果另一个基地的随从将被摧毁，它的主人可以将其移动到这里。

bases.name: Equaria
bases.text: After you play a minion here, you may move one of your minions from another base to here.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以将你的一个随从从另一个基地移动到这里。

bases.name: Pony Land
bases.text: If you have two or more minions here, your minions here cannot be destroyed.
bases.textZh: 如果你在这里有两个或更多随从，你在这里的随从就不会被消灭。

bases.name: Beautiful Castle
bases.text: Minions here with printed power 5 or greater are not affected by opponents’ cards.
bases.errata: Yes, Functional (now only checks printed power)
bases.textZh: 这里印有 5 或更高力量的随从不会受到对手卡牌的影响。
bases.errataZh: 有（功能性：现仅检查印制力量）

bases.name: Ice Castle
bases.text: Minions cannot be played here.
bases.textZh: 这里不能玩随从。

bases.name: Monkey Lab
bases.text: Minions here get +1 power for each action played on them.
bases.textZh: 这里的随从对他们进行的每个战术都会获得 +1 力量。

bases.name: Primate Park
bases.text: After this base scores, the winner may return any number of their actions on minions here back into his or her hand.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，获胜者可以将任意数量打出到此处随从上的战术移回其手上。

bases.name: Faceless City
bases.text: Once per turn, after you play a minion here, you may search your deck for a copy of that minion, reveal it, and place it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，当你在此处打出随从后，你可以从牌组中搜索该随从的一张副本，展示并加入你的手上，然后洗牌。

bases.name: The Vats
bases.text: You may not play a minion here that has the same name as another minion here.
bases.textZh: 你不能在这里打出与另一个随从同名的随从。

bases.name: ISI's Swingin' Pad
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may look at cards from any player's deck equal to its printed power. Return them in any order.
bases.textZh: 当你每回合第一次在这里打出随从后，你可以从任何玩家的牌组中查看等于其打印力量的牌。以任何顺序返回它们。

bases.name: Secret Volcano Headquarters
bases.text: Before this base scores, if you have a minion here, reveal the top card of your deck and play it here if it is a minion.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，如果你这里有一个随从，展示你牌组顶牌，如果它是一个随从，就在这里打出它。

bases.name: Portal Room
bases.text: The winner takes an extra turn after the current turn ends
bases.textZh: 当前回合结束后，获胜者获得额外回合

bases.name: The Nexus
bases.text: After this base scores (before being replaced), the winner may place a base from the base discard pile on top of the base deck.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后（替换前），获胜者可以将基地弃牌堆中的一张基地牌放到基地牌组顶。

bases.name: Clown College
bases.text: After the first time each turn you play a minion here, you may place a random standard action from your discard pile into your hand.
bases.textZh: 每回合首次在此处打出随从后，你可以将弃牌堆中的一张随机战术加入你的手上。

bases.name: The Big Top
bases.text: After you play a minion here, reveal the top card of your deck. If it is an action you may discard it, otherwise return it.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，展示你牌组顶牌。如果它是一个战术，你可以丢弃它，否则返回它。

bases.name: Goblin Caves
bases.text: After this base scores, each player with a minion here may flip a coin. If heads, they gain 1 VP. If tails, they discard two cards.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，每个拥有随从的玩家都可以掷硬币。如果正面，他们将获得 1 VP。如果出现反面，他们会丢弃两张牌。

bases.name: Goblin Town
bases.text: After you play a minion here, flip a coin. If heads, place a +1 power counter on that minion.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，掷硬币。如果正面，则在该随从上放置一个+1战斗力标记。

bases.name: Camelot
bases.set: Smash Up: Knights of the Round Table
bases.text: Minions here of printed power 4 or more cannot be affected by other players’ cards. On your turn, you may move one of your minions from here to another base.
bases.textZh: 这里的印制力量为 4 或以上的随从不会受到其他玩家卡牌的影响。轮到你的时候，你可以将你的一个随从从这里移动到另一个基地。
bases.errataZh: 有（功能性：将“力量”改为“印制力量”）

bases.name: Round Table
bases.set: Smash Up: Knights of the Round Table
bases.text: Each of your minions here with the same printed power as another one of your minions here has +1 power.
bases.textZh: 你这里的每个随从与你这里的另一个随从具有相同的印刷力量，都有+1力量。

bases.name: Hotel of Holiness
bases.text: 2 Undead Monsters. After the first time each turn you play a minion here, choose "minion" or "action" and shuffle a random card of that type from your discard pile into your deck.
bases.textZh: 2 个不死怪兽。每回合首次在此处打出随从后，选择“随从”或“战术”；将你弃牌堆中该类型的一张随机牌洗入你的牌组。

bases.name: Whack-a-Ghoul
bases.text: 1 Undead Monster Per Player. If you have a minion here, you may use your regular action play to destroy an undead monster here. You may play a treasure from destroying it as an extra card.
bases.textZh: 每名玩家 1 个不死怪兽。如果你在这里有一个随从，你可以使用你的常规战术来摧毁这里的不死怪兽。你可以通过摧毁宝藏来打出它作为额外的卡牌。

bases.name: The Mines
bases.text: 2 Monsters. Once per turn after you play a minion here, you may look at cards from the treasure deck equal to its power and place them on the top and/or bottom of that deck in any order.
bases.textZh: 2 怪兽。每回合一次，当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以从宝藏牌组中查看与其力量相等的牌，并将它们以任意顺序放置在该牌组的顶部和/或底部。

bases.name: Treasure Bath
bases.text: 1 Monster. After the first time each turn that you play a minion here, draw a treasure card.
bases.textZh: 1 怪兽。在你第一次在这里打出随从的每个回合后，抽一张宝藏卡。

bases.name: Helper's Hollow
bases.text: 2 Monsters. During each player’s turn, other players’ minions here have +1 power.
bases.textZh: 2 怪兽。在每个玩家的回合中，其他玩家的随从拥有+1力量。

bases.name: Treehouse
bases.text: 2 Monsters. When this base scores, the runner-up draws a card for each minion the winner has here.
bases.textZh: 2 怪兽。当此基地计分时，亚军为获胜者在这里拥有的每个随从抽一张牌。

bases.name: Birthday Party
bases.text: 1 Monster. After you play a minion on another base, if you do not have a minion here, you must discard a card.
bases.textZh: 1 怪兽。当你在另一个基地打出随从后，如果你这里没有随从，你必须弃掉一张牌。

bases.name: Subterranean Lair
bases.text: 1 Monster. On your turn, if you have no minions on this base, you may play an extra minion here.
bases.textZh: 1 怪兽。在你的回合中，如果你在此基地上没有随从，你可以在这里打出一个额外的随从。

bases.name: Dimension Doors
bases.text: 1 Monster. Once per turn after you play a minion here, you may discard a card to play an extra minion here.
bases.textZh: 1 怪兽。每回合一次，当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以弃掉一张牌来在这里打出一个额外的随从。

bases.name: Mage's Tower
bases.text: 1 Monster. After the first time each turn you play a minion here, you must discard a card and draw two cards.
bases.textZh: 1 怪兽。每回合你第一次在这里打出随从后，你必须弃掉一张牌并抽两张牌。

bases.name: Garrison
bases.text: 1 Monster. After this base scores, the winner may look at one card from the top of their deck for each of their minions here and play or draw one of them, then return the rest in any order.
bases.textZh: 1 怪兽。在此基地计分后，获胜者可以从牌组顶部为每个随从查看一张牌，并打出或抽出其中一张牌，然后以任意顺序返回其余牌。

bases.name: The Pits
bases.text: 3 Monsters. Once per turn, when you directly affect a minion here with a standard action, you may choose a monster here to be affected in the same way.
bases.textZh: 3个怪兽。每回合一次，当你用一张标准战术直接影响这里的一个随从时，你可以选择这里的一个怪兽以同样的方式受到影响。

bases.name: The Coffers
bases.text: 3 Monsters. After this base scores, players here may either draw a treasure card OR discard treasures from their hand equal to their VP award here to gain 1 VP.
bases.textZh: 3 个怪兽。在此基地计分后，此处的玩家可以抽一张宝藏牌，或从手上弃掉价值等于其 VP 奖励的宝藏以获得 1 VP。

bases.name: Thieves' Guild
bases.text: 1 Monster. Before this base scores, each player here reveals their hand. The players who reveal the most actions may each destroy a minion here.
bases.textZh: 1 个怪兽。在此基地计分前，此处的每名玩家亮出其手牌。亮出战术最多的玩家各可以消灭此处的一名随从。

bases.name: The Gauntlet
bases.text: 3 Monsters. After you destroy a monster here, you may play a monster here.
bases.textZh: 3个怪兽。当你在这里消灭了一个怪兽之后，你可以在这里打出一个怪兽。

bases.name: Ice Floe
bases.text: At the start of your turn, you may place one of your minions here on the bottom of its owner's deck to play a minion off the top of your deck here as an extra minion.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，你可以将你的一个随从放置在其拥有者牌组的底部，以将你牌组顶部的一个随从作为额外的随从。

bases.name: The Colony
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here on your turn, you may play a minion here off the top of your deck as an extra minion.
bases.textZh: 当你第一次在你的回合中在这里打出一个随从后，你可以在你的牌组顶部打出一个随从作为额外的随从。

bases.name: Base
bases.text: Before this base scores, destroy the minion(s) here with the least power. If tied, destroy all tied minions.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，以最小的力量消灭这里的随从。如果被绑住，消灭所有被绑住的随从。

bases.name: Camp Clear Lake
bases.text: After you destroy a minion here, give its amount of power to a minion here until the end of the turn. Once per turn, after you play a card here, you may destroy a minion here with power less than or equal to the number of your cards here.
bases.textZh: 当你消灭这里的一个随从后，将其力量赋予这里的一个随从，直到回合结束。每回合一次，当你在这里打出一张卡牌后，你可以消灭这里的一个力量小于或等于你在这里的卡牌数量的随从。

bases.name: Cabin in the Woods
bases.text: If you have at least two minions here, your minions here each have +2 power.
bases.imageAlt: Cabin in the Woods · Smash Up
bases.textZh: 如果你这里至少有两个随从，那么你这里的每个随从都有+2力量。

bases.name: Montridge High
bases.text: After you play a minion here, place a +1 counter on one of your minions with a different name here.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，在你的一个不同名字的随从上放置一个+1标记。

bases.name: Boogie Wonderland
bases.text: After a player plays a standard action that affects one or more of their minions here, they draw a card.
bases.textZh: 当玩家执行一个影响其一个或多个随从的标准战术后，他们会抽一张牌。

bases.name: Funky Town
bases.text: Once per turn, when your standard action directly affects one or more of your minions here, you may have it affect another of your minions here the same way.
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，当你的标准战术直接影响这里的一个或多个随从时，你可以让它以同样的方式影响这里的另一个随从。

bases.name: Ancient Dojo
bases.text: After you play a minion here, place a +1 power counter on each of your minions here with less power than that minion.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，在你的每个随从身上放置一个+1战斗力标记，其力量比该随从小。

bases.name: Tournament Site
bases.text: When this base scores, the winner gains 1VP for each player with no power here.
bases.textZh: 当此基地计分时，获胜者为每个没有力量的玩家获得 1VP。

bases.name: The Greasy Spoon
bases.text: When an action played on this base would go to the discard pile, shuffle it into its owner’s deck instead.
bases.textZh: 当在此基地上打出的战术将进入弃牌堆时，请将其洗入其所有者的牌库中。

bases.name: Truck Stop
bases.text: At the start of your turn, you may transfer an action played on another base to here, or from here to another base.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，你可以将在另一个基地进行的战术转移到这里，或从这里转移到另一个基地。

bases.name: Back Alley
bases.text: Your minions here cannot be affected by other players' cards.
bases.textZh: 你在这里的随从不会受到其他玩家卡牌的影响。

bases.name: The Mean Streets
bases.text: Before this base scores, destroy the minion(s) here with the most power.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，消灭这里力量最大的随从。

bases.name: TableTop
bases.text: The winner draws 3 cards, then discards 2 cards.
bases.textZh: 获胜者抽3张牌，然后弃掉 2 张牌。

bases.name: The Con
bases.text: When a minion is played here, other minions here of that faction gain +1 power until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 当一个随从在这里打出时，该派系的其他随从获得+1力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Locker Room
bases.text: At the start of your turn, if you have a minion here, draw a card.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，如果你这里有随从，则抽一张牌。

bases.name: Stadium
bases.text: After a minion here is destroyed, its controller draws a card.
bases.textZh: 当此处的随从被消灭后，其操控者抽一张牌。

bases.name: Antarctic Base
bases.text: You may only play one minion here each turn.
bases.textZh: 每回合你只能在这里打出一个随从。

bases.name: Plateau of Leng
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may play an extra minion here with the same name.
bases.textZh: 每回合你第一次在这里打出一个随从后，你可以在这里额外打出一个同名的随从。

bases.name: Innsmouth
bases.text: After each time a minion is played here, its owner may place one card from any player’s discard pile on the bottom of their deck.
bases.textZh: 每次在这里打出一个随从后，它的拥有者可以将任何玩家的弃牌堆中的一张牌放在他们的牌组底部。

bases.name: Ritual Site
bases.text: After this base scores, all minions on it are shuffled into their owners’ decks.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，其上的所有随从都会被洗入其所有者的牌组中。

bases.name: Mountains of Madness
bases.text: After each time a minion is played here, its owner draws a Madness card.
bases.textZh: 每次在这里打出一个随从后，它的主人都会抽一张疯狂卡。

bases.name: R'lyeh
bases.text: At the start of each player’s turn, that player may destroy one of their minion’s here. If they do, they gain 1 VP.
bases.textZh: 在每个玩家的回合开始时，该玩家可以在这里消灭他们的一个随从。如果他们这样做，他们将获得 1 VP。

bases.name: Arkham University
bases.text: Once per turn after you play a minion here, you may either draw two Madness cards, or discard a Madness card from your hand, to play an extra action.
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，在你于此处打出随从后，你可以抽两张疯狂牌；或从手上弃掉一张疯狂牌，以打出一张额外战术。

bases.name: Asylum
bases.text: After you play a minion here, you may place a card from your hand in the box to place a +1 power counter on one of your minions.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以将一张手牌放入盒子中，在你的一个随从上放置一个+1战斗力标记。

bases.name: Ancient Temple
bases.text: At the start of your turn, if you have only one minion here, it gains +5 power while it is here until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，如果你这里只有一个随从，那么它在此期间获得+5力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: City of Gold
bases.text: At the start of your turn, if you have a minion here, gain 1VP.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，如果你这里有随从，则获得 1VP。

bases.name: Grandma's House
bases.text: After you play a minion here, look at the top card of your deck. Place it on the top or bottom of your deck.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，查看你牌组顶牌。将其放在牌组的顶部或底部。

bases.name: Retirement Community
bases.text: After this base scores, each player may place one of their minions here on the top or bottom of their deck instead of the discard pile.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，每个玩家都可以将他们的一个随从放在他们牌组的顶部或底部，而不是放在弃牌堆上。

bases.name: Lake Minnetonka
bases.text: After you play or move a minion to here, it gains +1 power until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 当你使用或移动一个随从到这里后，它会获得+1力量直到回合结束。

bases.name: Palooza
bases.text: Before this base scores, each player may move one of their minions to here.
bases.textZh: 在这个在此基地计分前，每个玩家都可以将他们的一个随从移到这里。

bases.name: Out in the Woods
bases.text: Before this base scores, each minion here gains +1 power until the end of the turn.
bases.imageAlt: Out in the Woods · Smash Up
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，这里的每个随从都会获得+1力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Under the Bed
bases.text: On your turn, you may play an extra minion of power 2 or less here if you have played one or more minions at other bases this turn.
bases.textZh: 如果您本回合在其他基地使用了一个或多个随从，则在您的回合中，您可以在此额外打出一个力量为 2 或更少的随从。

bases.name: Anansi's Web
bases.text: If you have a minion here, after the first time each turn you play a standard action, you may place it into another player’s hand instead of the discard pile to draw two cards.
bases.textZh: 如果你这里有一个随从，在你每回合第一次打出一张标准战术后，你可以将其放入另一个玩家的手上而不是弃牌堆中以抽两张牌。

bases.name: Storyteller's Hut
bases.text: On your turn, you may play an extra action to place a counter on this card. This base’s breakpoint is reduced by 2 for each of those counters.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，你可以打出一张额外战术，在此基地牌上放置一个标记。此基地的临界点每有一个此标记便减少 2。

bases.name: Cuzcu
bases.text: This base’s breakpoint is reduced by 3 for each action on it.
bases.textZh: 此基地上的每张战术使其临界点减少 3。

bases.name: Machu Picchu
bases.text: After you play an action on this base, draw a card.
bases.textZh: 当你在此基地上打出一张战术后，抽一张牌。

bases.name: Gingerbread House
bases.text: Before this base scores, each player may choose two of their minions here with the same power to gain +2 power until the end of the turn.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，每名玩家可以选择此处两名力量相同的随从；它们获得 +2 力量直到回合结束。

bases.name: Woodland Cottage
bases.text: Once per turn, after you play a minion here, you may search your deck for a minion of power 3 or less and place it into your hand.
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，当你在此处打出随从后，你可以从牌组中搜索一名力量为 3 或以下的随从，并加入你的手上。

bases.name: Island Chain
bases.text: After this base scores, play the top card of the base deck as an extra base.
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分后，打出基地牌库的顶牌作为额外的基地牌。

bases.name: Island Peak
bases.text: At the start of your turn, if you have exactly one minion here, place a +1 power counter on it.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，如果你这里只有一个随从，则在其上放置一个+1战斗力标记。

bases.name: Tropical Paradise
bases.text: If each player has one or more minions on this base, its starting breakpoint is 0.
bases.textZh: 如果每个玩家在此基地上有一个或多个随从，则其起始临界点为 0。

bases.name: Giant Turnip
bases.text: This base’s breakpoint is reduced by 1 for each minion on it.
bases.textZh: 每有一个随从，此基地的临界点就会减少 1。

bases.name: Transformation Spring
bases.text: Once during your turn, after you play a minion here, you may place it on the bottom of its owner's deck to play a minion off the top of your deck here as an extra minion.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合中，当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以将它放在其拥有者牌组的底部，然后从你的牌组顶部打出一个随从作为额外的随从。

bases.name: Ringside
bases.text: After you play an action that directly affects another player’s minion here, draw a card.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里进行一个直接影响其他玩家随从的战术后，抽一张牌。

bases.name: The Squared Circle
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here each turn, you may place a random action from your discard pile into your hand.
bases.textZh: 每回合首次在此处打出随从后，你可以将弃牌堆中的一张随机战术加入你的手上。

bases.name: Great White North, Eh?
bases.text: Before this base scores, each player may move one of their minions from here to another base and give it +1 power until the end of turn.
bases.imageAlt: Great White North, Eh? · Smash Up
bases.textZh: 在此基地计分前，每个玩家可以将他们的一个随从从这里移动到另一个基地，并给予它+1力量，直到回合结束。

bases.name: Strategic Syrup Reserve
bases.text: After you play a minion here, you may move another player’s minion to here from a base where you have a minion.
bases.textZh: 当你在这里打出一个随从后，你可以将另一个玩家的随从从你拥有随从的基地移动到这里。

bases.name: Bastion Saint-Gervais
bases.text: Once per turn after you play an action that directly affects one of your minions here, you may play an extra action.
bases.textZh: 每回合一次，在你执行一个直接影响你的一个随从的战术后，你可以打出一张额外战术。

bases.name: The Golden Lily
bases.text: At the end of your turn, if you have a minion here, draw a card.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合结束时，如果你这里有随从，则抽一张牌。

bases.name: Heya Training Stable
bases.text: At the start of your turn, you may discard a card to place a +1 power counter on one of your minions here.
bases.textZh: 在你的回合开始时，你可以弃掉一张牌，在你的一个随从身上放置一个+1战斗力标记。

bases.name: The Dohyo
bases.text: After the first time you play a minion here on your turn, you may move another player’s minion from here to another base.
bases.textZh: 当你第一次在你的回合中在这里打出一个随从后，你可以将另一个玩家的随从从这里移动到另一个基地。
